source.pc: In this skill you learn to add/subtract fractions with variables, like turning into . This includes multiplying both sides of a fraction by a factor to get an equal denominator, expanding (often double) brackets, and subsequently adding together the two like fractions. The skill does not require the cancellation of potential polynomial fractions afterwards.

target.pc: In deze vaardigheid leer je om breuken met variabelen op te tellen/af te trekken, zoals het herschrijven van in . Dit omvat het vermenigvuldigen van beide kanten van een breuk met een factor om dezelfde noemer te krijgen, het uitwerken van (vaak dubbele) haakjes, en het vervolgens optellen van de twee gelijknamige breuken. Deze vaardigheid gaat niet over het achteraf nog wegstrepen van potentiële polynome factoren.

source.pc: We want to add/subtract two unlike fractions (fractions with unequal denominator), such as We know how to add two like fractions (with equal denominators), but this time our fractions do not have equal denominators. To still be able to add these two fractions, we first must force them to have the same denominator.

To do so, we take the left fraction and multiply both the numerator and the denominator by (that is, the denominator of the other fraction). This turns into . Note that this is the same: we could even cancel the factor again to get back to where we started. Identically, we also take the right fraction, and multiply its numerator and denominator by (the denominator of the first fraction). This turns into . Altogether, we may hence write And now we have two fractions with equal denominator!
